description:
This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

In modern war, training matters... until it doesn’t.
This video tells three true, contemporary stories where survival came down to inches, timing, and pure chance. From a British soldier who lay on a live grenade, to a truck driver who unknowingly outran a precision-guided bomb, to a Ukrainian sniper who survived again and again by the smallest margins imaginable.
